notes: Line 1 word 2: Griffith writes sic over a stroke+3 that looks like q (table '13'); the expected word is soreyi. Line 1 word 3 (k?d?l s?li) and the name in lines 1-2 are unsure; '2' plus long-tailed 3 could also be a. The divider-free right group of row 4 ('to?iwidye?qowi') starts with a small loop sign that may be to or w. Row 6 'aḫ? : mẖ?e' parallels row 7 'at mḫe'; the sign read ḫ after a may be t. 'qowi' read from the recurring group stroke-stroke-3 + w + i. In row 7, the two signs after r (a rising hook and a c-shape) are uncertain (b? ḫ?).

Line 9 ends with a 4 under the number 9; read o(9)i, w perhaps omitted. ẖ read for 3-shaped signs in 'mẖe' (no c-shaped ḫ there). Line 12 start is unclear: c-shape, 3, slash, then 13 shape (q?).
